title: Curved Curl Support Plate And Arched Neck Strap
description: One newly authored complete static arm-blaster-inspired accessory. A single wide finite-thickness support plate has an integral continuous bowed centre and two reversely curved outer elbow wings, with a gently changing upper edge and one continuous flat lower resting edge. One whole wide rectangular-section strap forms a tall fixed open arch behind the plate and seats at both shoulders. Two complete proud connector studs and a thicker continuous curved neck-pad sleeve finish the accessory. All five whole closed meshes are newly drawn, no prior cuff, machine pad, mask strap or body armour geometry imported or extracted. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One original model and zero scenes. Empty fixed sculptural resting presentation only; the frozen strap is not simulated textile and no wearer or weight is included. Category-inspired game prop, not an exact commercial item. No actual body fit, restraint, padding response, exercise instruction or benefit, flexibility, dynamic stability, load rating, material specification, manufacture, clinical purpose or safety capability. No rigging, animation or interaction.
